mechanism_of_action: Dasatinib and quercetin are described as senolytics that target senescent cells.
primary_endpoint: Adverse events and study feasibility over the 3-week dosing period.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events related to dasatinib and quercetin were reported. Sleep disturbances and anxiety occurred in 4/6 participants receiving dasatinib and quercetin versus 0/6 receiving placebo.
